title: Hearing on the City's new pied-à-terre tax rollout
summary: The Council's Governmental Operations and Finance Committees held an oversight hearing on how the Department of Finance is implementing the new state-created pied-à-terre tax on non-primary residences worth over $5 million (class one homes) or $1 million (condos and co-ops). The hearing examined confusion and litigation over an initial list of nearly one million flagged properties, of which only about 24,000 meet the value threshold, and DOF's decision to send warning letters to 17,000 owners. It also reviewed the appeals process, including a deadline extended to September 18, 2026, for owners to contest the tax.
